RiskAuditGuide.title: Risk & Audit Guide
RiskAuditGuide.subtitle: Get a free short comment on the listing — and see when a full PROVIN AUDITS is worth it.

step1.question: What’s the car’s context?
step1.hint: Helps us understand the situation — not a product filter. Full history (also for Latvia-used cars) usually means PROVIN AUDITS.

step2.title: Free short review
step2.hint: 3–5 sentences by email in 24–48h about what is visible in the listing. No database / VIN analysis.

form.boundary: Public listing only — not an audit and not a consultation.

success.title: Request received.
success.body: We’ll reply within 24–48h with a short look at the listing. If you already know you need full history — PROVIN AUDITS is the next step.

errors.listing: Paste a valid link to a specific listing.
